name: Deadlands: The Weird West
description: Savage Worlds' own original flagship setting — the game the whole system was built to run before it was ever spun off as a generic engine. An alternate 1800s American frontier where the Reckoners, a collection of evil spirits trapped in the otherdimensional Hunting Grounds, have begun turning Earth into a nightmare-fueled hellscape. Ghost rock, a mysterious super-fuel unique to this timeline, has spawned as much steampunk ingenuity as war and strife. Player characters are steely-eyed gunfighters, card-slinging sorcerers called Hucksters, mad scientists, shamans, and savage braves, all fighting to hold back the Reckoning one haunted town at a time.
